post.description: Creates a data subject request in HeyPoplar.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

subjectRequestId.description: Unique UUID v4 identifier for the request.

subjectRequestType.description: Request type. Supported values: access or erasure.

subjectIdentities[].description: Array of subject identity objects with identity_type, identity_format, and identity_value.

post.description: Creates a new mailer in HeyPoplar.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

campaignId.description: ID of the campaign to use for the mailing.

creativeId.description: Optional creative ID. If omitted, Poplar uses the default creative.

sendAt.description: Future ISO8601 timestamp for when the mailing should be sent.

recipient.fullName.description: Optional recipient name. Poplar uses Current Resident if omitted.

back_url.description: Public URL to the back preview image from the official Poplar mailing response example.

creative_id.description: Creative identifier from the official Poplar mailing response example.

front_url.description: Public URL to the front preview image from the official Poplar mailing response example.

id.description: Mailer identifier from the official Poplar mailing response example.

pdf_url.description: Public URL to the PDF preview from the official Poplar mailing response example.

get.description: Retrieves creatives for a HeyPoplar campaign.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

get.description: Retrieves mailings for a HeyPoplar campaign.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: ID of the campaign whose mailings should be returned.

schema.description: ID of the campaign whose mailings should be returned.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Return only mailings created after this ISO8601 timestamp.

schema.description: Return only mailings created after this ISO8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Return only mailings created before this ISO8601 timestamp.

schema.description: Return only mailings created before this ISO8601 timestamp.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

address.description: Recipient address object from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

back_url.description: Public URL to the back preview image from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 created-at timestamp from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

creative_id.description: Creative identifier from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

front_url.description: Public URL to the front preview image from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

id.description: Mailer identifier from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

merge_tags.description: Merge tag object from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

pdf_url.description: Public URL to the PDF preview from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

state.description: Mailing state from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.

total_cost.description: Total cost string from the official Poplar campaign mailings response example.
